extracted.name: Frosted Grapes
extracted.description: These frosted grapes are made with cherry-flavored gelatin mix. This two-ingredient recipe makes a simple yet elegant treat. They'll be an instant hit.
ingredient_lines: 1 (3 ounce) package cherry flavored Jell-O® mix
instruction_lines: Remove grapes from stems; rinse in a colander. Pour gelatin mix on a plate. Roll grapes in gelatin mix, one handful at a time, until coated.
Transfer to a pretty dish; refrigerate until gelatin is set, about 1 hour.
